enchantment.soulkeeper.soulbound.desc: Keeps this item in your inventory when you die, at the cost of durability.
item.soulkeeper.soul_compass.unbound: This compass is not bound to a soul. Use it on a Soul Anchor.
item.soulkeeper.soul_compass.bound: The compass now points to this Soul Anchor.
item.soulkeeper.soul_compass.other_dimen: Your soul rests in another dimension: %s
death.soulkeeper.grave: Your gear is sealed in a Soul Anchor in %s at %s %s %s. A Soul Compass will guide you back.
